policy.display_name: NIST fit-for-purpose + COCO metrics + corruption robustness demo gate

model_A_rep.policy_name: NIST fit-for-purpose + COCO metrics + corruption robustness demo gate

g1_clean_map50.description: Clean reference performance must remain operationally credible on COCO-style AP50.

g2_adverse_map50.description: Performance under adverse/critical scenarios must remain above a minimum functional floor.

g3_rpc50.description: Relative performance under corruption should remain at or above 65% of clean-reference AP50.

g4_critical_failure_count.description: No mission-critical scenario may fall below the critical failure floor.

model_A_rep.notes: Revision retrain (the experiment machine, 2026-10-29). Same as A: yolo11n.pt, 4-class train only, 01 script (epochs 45, weak augmentation), seed 42; --workers 4.
